label: Zone Management
description:
Create and manage zones and triggers.
Supports creating multiple types of zones, such as motion zones for detecting motion,
or privacy zones for hiding a certain part of a video stream.

This differs from the Multiple Zone Presence capability. While the Multiple Zone Presence
capability is specifically for reporting presence of people in a zone, Zone Management allows
for creating different types of zones, including motion zones that trigger when motion is
detected. However, motion detection does not neccessarily equate to presence detection, so
these capabilities are meant to be used for different purposes.

supportedFeatures.label: Supported features
supportedFeatures.description: Use to indicate additional optional features that can be supported on zones and triggers.

maxZones.label: Max zones
maxZones.description:
The maximum number of zones that can be used. This includes both manufacturer-defined and
user-defined zones. The number of user-defined zones that are able to be created at any time
can be generally determined by the difference between this value and the number of items in
the array of the zones attribute.

sensitivity.label: Sensitivity
sensitivity.description: The global sensitivity setting for zones.

zones.label: Zones
zones.description: List of zones that can be used for triggers. The vertices for each zone must be non-intersecting.

triggers.label: Triggers
triggers.description: List of triggers that can be linked to zones

sensitivityRange.label: Sensitivity range
sensitivityRange.description: The range of sensitivity values that can be used for a zone.

triggeredZones.label: Triggered zones
triggeredZones.description: List of zones that are actively being triggered

removeTrigger.label: removeTrigger
removeTrigger.description: Remove a trigger from a zone

zoneId.description: The ID of the zone to remove the trigger from.

polygonVertices.description: The coordinates that define the zone region as a polygon.

color.description: The color to use for this zone in 6 or 8 digit sRGB hex color notation

use.description: The use case for the zone.

name.description: Label to use for the zone.

sensitivity.description: The global sensitivity level of zones.

updateZone.label: updateZone
updateZone.description: Update a user-defined zone. This cannot be called on a manufacturer-defined zone

polygonVertices.description: The coordinates that define the zone region as a polygon.

color.description: The color to use for this zone in 6 or 8 digit sRGB hex color notation

use.description: The use case for the zone.

name.description: Label to use for the zone.

zoneId.description: The ID of the zone to update.

removeZone.label: removeZone
removeZone.description: Remove a user-defined zone. This cannot be called on a manufacturer-defined zone

zoneId.description: The ID of the zone to remove.

createOrUpdateTrigger.label: createOrUpdateTrigger
createOrUpdateTrigger.description: Create a new trigger or update an existing one for a motion zone

augmentationDuration.description: The duration by which the trigger period should be extended if a zone triggers again while already triggered.

zoneId.description:
ID of the zone to link to this trigger. Triggers can only be associated with motion zones, not
privacy or focus zones.

blindDuration.description: The duration after a zone has stopped triggering before it can trigger again.

sensitivity.description:
The sensitivity level of the zone this trigger is associated with. This is only used if perZoneSensitivity is supported.
Otherwise, the sensitivity is defined by the global sensitivity attribute value.

initialDuration.description: The duration for which the trigger should be active after inital detection.

maxDuration.description: The maximum duration that a trigger can be active.
